name: ZeroTier
description: Connect privately through an authorized ZeroTier network.

providers.label: ZeroTier
providers.description: Connect privately through an authorized ZeroTier network.
providers.security: Both devices must belong to your authorized ZeroTier network. Configure DNS for the assigned network address and supply a browser-trusted TLS certificate. Recursive binds only that address and does not join or leave networks. You maintain DNS and certificate renewal.

schema.label: Network ID
schema.description: 16 hexadecimal characters. This device must already be authorized.

schema.label: Private HTTPS endpoint
schema.description: Hostname resolving to this ZeroTier address, including the HTTPS port, e.g. https://host.example.com:18447.

schema.label: TLS certificate (PEM)
schema.description: Browser-trusted certificate and intermediate chain for the hostname.

schema.label: TLS private key (PEM)
schema.description: Unencrypted private key matching the certificate.
